pages.text: Cut grass with a $(thing)hoe$() for $(thing)Cut Grass$(), and lay it on the ground in a $(thing)windrow$(). Over about a game day of fair weather it wilts, cures and dries; turn it with a hoe to hurry it along.
Rain on hay that has started to cure can spoil it into $(thing)mouldy hay$(), only fit for compost. Gather dry windrows for $(thing)Dried Hay$(): nine make a hay bale, and animals eat it too.
